It ended up in the (Naismith) Hall of Fame (earlier this year) and I am so thankful that I was able to coach and play as long as I did. For the first time, I can focus on giving TV my 100% attention, which I'm really looking forward to." Rivers, 65, will join his son, Austin, who also is an analyst for NBC Sports. The elder Rivers concluded his head coaching career after stepping down from his post with the Milwaukee Bucks in April. He was inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in August as part of the Class of 2026. Doc Rivers completed his 27th year on an NBA bench and has a record of 1,194-866. He is sixth in victories on the all-time list and guided the 2007-08 Boston Celtics to an NBA championship. The 13-year NBA guard started his coaching career with the Orlando Magic in the 1999-2000 season. He earned NBA Coach of the Year honors in that first season, posting a 41-41 record. Rivers coached in Orlando until 2004, before jumping to the Celtics in the 2004-05 season. His tenure in Boston was the longest at nine years (2004-13) and was followed by stints with the Los Angeles Clippers (2013-20), Philadelphia 76ers (2020-23) and Bucks (2024-26). The Chicago native began his NBA career in Atlanta and played for the Hawks from 1983-91. He also competed for the Clippers (1991-92), New York Knicks (1992-94) and San Antonio Spurs (1994-96). --Field Level Media

item.title: A l'Onu, Trump menace d'"annihiler" l'Iran, évoque un accord après les 'midterms'
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a utilisé mardi son discours devant l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies pour revendiquer que la guerre contre l'Iran a empêché Téhéran de se doter de l'arme nucléaire et pour menacer à nouveau d'"annihiler la République islamique" si aucun accord n'est trouvé.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a utilisé mardi son discours devant l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies pour revendiquer que la guerre contre l'Iran a empêché Téhéran de se doter de l'arme nucléaire et pour menacer à nouveau d'"annihiler la République islamique" si aucun accord n'est trouvé. Fidèle à sa manière de communiquer sur le conflit, déclenché en février dernier par les bombardements des Etats-Unis et d'Israël en Iran, avec tantôt des commentaires [USN:L8N442098 TEXT:"optimistes"] tantôt des [USN:L8N44S03L TEXT:"menaces"], le chef de la Maison blanche a également dit penser qu'un accord sur une fin du conflit serait conclu après les élections de mi-mandat au Congrès américain ("[USN:L8N4560J1 TEXT:"midterms"]"), le 3 novembre, pour lesquelles son Parti républicain bataille en vue de conserver la majorité dans les deux chambres. A la tribune de l'Assemblée générale, Donald Trump a exhorté les pays à imiter les Etats-Unis en [USN:L8N44L1JG TEXT:"isolant économiquement"] l'Iran afin de le contraindre à négocier. Un haut responsable iranien a déclaré plus tôt dans la journée à Reuters que Téhéran pourrait [USN:L8N45E0K5 TEXT:"rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz"], fermé de facto en réponse aux bombardements américano-israéliens, dans un délai de sept jours si Washington allège la pression militaire contre l'Iran et lève son blocus des ports iraniens. "J'ai une grande décision à prendre", a déclaré Donald Trump. "Un accord va-t-il être conclu avec l'Iran pour les laisser rebâtir et créer un pays bien meilleur qu'il ne l'a jamais été ? Ou est-ce que j'annihile la République islamique, et je le fais rapidement, sans jamais plus leur donner une chance de tuer et détruire encore des gens et des peuples ?". "Est-ce que je les emmène en enfer sans chance de survie et sans espoir de grandeur ou de générations futures ?", a-t-il poursuivi. "Mais je pense que l'on fera un accord juste après les élections" au Congrès. Le président américain a déjà prévenu à plusieurs reprises ces derniers mois qu'il pourrait détruire toutes les infrastructures énergétiques et les ponts d'Iran, et s'est affranchi de toute limite en menaçant un temps d'"[USN:L8N40Q1CT TEXT:"anéantir toute la civilisation iranienne"]" s'il n'obtenait pas de Téhéran un accord prévoyant la réouverture du détroit d'Ormuz. Bombarder délibérément des infrastructures civiles est une violation du droit humanitaire international et peut constituer un [USN:L6N40J1DH TEXT:"crime de guerre"]. Viser délibérément de manière massive une population civile peut constituer un crime de guerre ou un génocide. "ILS ATTENDENT DE VOIR COMMENT JE M'EN SORS AUX ÉLECTIONS" Donald Trump a utilisé son discours à l'Onu pour revendiquer à nouveau la pertinence de la guerre lancée contre l'Iran, huit mois après les bombardements américano-israéliens contre les principaux sites nucléaires iraniens en juin 2025 lors de la "[USN:L8N3SQ21J TEXT:"Guerre de Douze jours"]". Ces sites avaient été "[USN:L8N3SR249 TEXT:"complètement anéantis"]", avait-il dit à l'époque. Le président américain a évoqué par le passé diverses raisons [USN:L8N3ZR3AV TEXT:"pour justifier"] la campagne militaire lancée en février dernier, dont le programme nucléaire iranien, le soutien de Téhéran à des milices régionales et l'objectif d'un changement de régime en Iran. Washington et Téhéran avaient entamé en début d'année un cycle de [USN:L8N3ZM0QU TEXT:"pourparlers sur le nucléaire"], qualifié de "positif" par Oman, médiateur de ces négociations. L'Iran, qui nie de longue date vouloir développer une arme atomique, a fait l'objet ce mois-ci d'une résolution de l'Agence internationale de l'énergie atomique (AIEA) [USN:L8N45122Q TEXT:"pour signaler"] au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu des manquements à ses obligations de non-prolifération. Téhéran a commencé en 2019 à s'affranchir des restrictions fixées par l'accord international de 2015 sur son programme nucléaire, abandonné un an plus tôt par Donald Trump - lors de son premier mandat - qui a rétabli les sanctions américaines. "Je pense que nous conclurons un accord juste après les élections parce qu'il n'est pas logique pour eux de ne pas le faire", a déclaré mardi Donald Trump lors de son discours. "Ils attendent de voir comment je m'en sors aux élections de mi-mandat", a-t-il ajouté à propos des responsables iraniens. Après son discours prononcé à New York, le président américain devait rencontrer plus d'une dizaine de dirigeants mondiaux, lors de réunions bilatérales ou en groupe, pour discuter notamment des guerres au Moyen-Orient et en Ukraine, qui constituent des défis pour sa politique étrangère. Il était prévu notamment que Donald Trump s'entretienne pour la première fois en personne avec le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham et qu'il rencontre son homologue ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky. Le chef de la Maison blanche a discuté lundi soir avec le président français Emmanuel Macron, qui a rapporté que les deux dirigeants ont évoqué des efforts destinés à obtenir [USN:L8N45E02Z TEXT:"un moratoire"] entre l'Ukraine et la Russie sur les frappes contre les sites énergétiques. La guerre en Iran a des répercussions mondiales, avec une flambée des prix de l'énergie. Les prix du carburant ont flambé aux Etats-Unis, ce qui a fait chuter à un plus bas inédit [USN:L8N45D1T6 TEXT:"la cote de popularité"] de Donald Trump, qui avait fait campagne en 2024 en promettant de ne plus entraîner l'Amérique dans des guerres sans fin. L'inflation est l'une des préoccupations majeures des électeurs américains en amont des "midterms", jetant une ombre sur l'objectif des républicains de conserver le contrôle des deux chambres du Congrès.

item.title: 米・デンマーク・グリーンランド、安保協定に署名 米軍駐留拡大へ
item.description:
Gram Slattery Jacob Gronholt-Pedersen
[国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　Jacob Gronholt-Pedersen

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領とデンマークおよび同国自治領グリーンランドの首脳は２２日、国連総会が開かれているニューヨークで、グリーンランドの安全保障に関する協定に署名した。

協定は、グリーンランドにおける米軍駐留規模の拡大を認める内容。関係筋によると、米国は同地に軍事拠点２カ所を設置する見通しだ。

トランプ大統領は同日午前の国連総会一般討論演説で、この協定により米国はグリーンランドでの「安全保障およびその他のあらゆるニーズに対する恒久的な支配権」を得ると説明。「今後、米国の敵対国がグリーンランドに軍事拠点を築いたり、機密性の高い投資を行ったりすることは、われわれの明確な書面による承認なしには決して許されない」と述べた。

トランプ氏は演説後、デンマークのフレデリクセン首相、グリーンランド自治政府のニールセン首相との三者会談を行い、協定に署名した。

デンマークは、協定によって、北極圏の安全保障を米国とデンマークだけが担うのではなく、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の監視下に置かれると説明している。

item.title: Turkey's Erdogan says 'global gender-neutralisation policies' target families, children
item.description: Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan condemned on Tuesday what he called "global gender-neutralisation policies", saying they had turned into a campaign targeting families and children.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan condemned on Tuesday what he called "global gender-neutralisation policies", saying they had turned into a campaign targeting families and children. Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdogan said the trend could be countered by protecting the traditional family formed by a man and a woman. His comments came a week after Turkish authorities launched [USN:L8N4580HX TEXT:"sweeping raids and arrests"] targeting LGBTQ+ groups under an operation dubbed "My Family is Safe", which the government says is aimed at protecting children and family values. Eighty-two people were jailed pending trial, while more than 100 protesters were also detained.

item.title: Schweiz: UBS-Chef und Finanzministerin beharren auf Kapital-Standpunkten
item.description: Am Tag vor einer ersten Entscheidung des Schweizer Parlaments zu schärferen Kapitalanforderungen für die UBS haben Konzernchef Sergio Ermotti und Finanzministerin Karin Keller-Sutter nochmals ihre scharf divergierenden Standpunkte dargelegt. "Die Frage ist: Wer haftet und wer trägt das Risiko?", fragte Keller-Sutter. "Ist es der Aktionär oder ist es der Staat?" Sie sprach sich auf der Konferenz "Finance Forum Zürich" am Dienstag erneut dafür aus, dass die UBS ihre Auslandstöchter mit 100 Prozent Kernkapital unterlegt. Ermotti lehnte diesen Vorschlag ab und führte dafür die hohen Kosten ins Feld, die die UBS bei einer Umsetzung des Regierungsvorschlages tragen müsste. Ermotti sprach auf derselben Veranstaltung direkt vor der Finanzministerin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Am Tag vor einer ersten Entscheidung des Schweizer Parlaments zu schärferen Kapitalanforderungen für die UBS (UBSG.S) haben Konzernchef Sergio Ermotti und Finanzministerin Karin Keller-Sutter nochmals ihre scharf divergierenden Standpunkte dargelegt. "Die Frage ist: Wer haftet und wer trägt das Risiko?", fragte Keller-Sutter. "Ist es der Aktionär oder ist es der Staat?" Sie sprach sich auf der Konferenz "Finance Forum Zürich" am Dienstag erneut dafür aus, dass die UBS ihre Auslandstöchter mit 100 Prozent Kernkapital unterlegt. Ermotti lehnte diesen Vorschlag ab und führte dafür die hohen Kosten ins Feld, die die UBS bei einer Umsetzung des Regierungsvorschlages tragen müsste. Ermotti sprach auf derselben Veranstaltung direkt vor der Finanzministerin. Am Mittwoch stimmt die kleine Kammer des Parlaments, der Ständerat, voraussichtlich über drei Varianten ab. Neben dem Regierungsvorschlag liegen zwei mildere Anträge vor. Die Wirtschaftskommission des Ständerats spricht sich für eine hälftige Aufteilung zwischen hartem Kernkapital und günstigeren AT1-Anleihen aus. In der Parlamentsdebatte vom vergangenen Donnerstag erhielt eine dritte Variante viel Zuspruch; demnach müsste die UBS die Auslandstöchter mit 90 Prozent Eigenkapital unterlegen. Seitdem haben Wirtschaftsverbände den Ständerat aufgefordert, von zu strengen Kapitalanforderungen abzusehen. Keller-Sutter erklärte am Dienstag, beim Antrag der Regierung (Bundesrat) handle es sich bereits um einen Kompromiss. Bei den Kapitalvorgaben im Zusammenhang mit latenten Steuerguthaben und Software sei der Bundesrat der UBS entgegengekommen. Sie deutete an, dass die Regierung diese Konzessionen kassieren könnte, falls das Parlament ihren Vorschlag zu stark verwässern würde. "Dann müssen wir darauf zurückkommen, dass wir eben zum Beispiel die Anrechenbarkeit von latenten Steuern überdenken." Nach dem Ständerat beugt sich die große Kammer (Nationalrat) voraussichtlich frühestens im Dezember über die Vorlage. Ermotti betonte die langfristigen Konsequenzen der Kapitalregeln: "Wir werden in den nächsten Wochen und Monaten die Zukunft des Finanzplatzes für die kommenden zehn, 20 Jahre festlegen."

item.title: What is in Brussels' 'Made in EU' law and why is Britain worried?
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Tuesday he would make the case for Britain to be considered a "trusted partner" under the European Union's proposed "Made in EU" rules, warning that excluding the UK could damage the British car industry.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Tuesday he would [USN:L8N45E0EA TEXT:"make the case"] for Britain to be considered a "trusted partner" under the European Union's proposed "Made in EU" rules, warning that excluding the UK could damage the British car industry. Here are the key points of the European Commission's [USN:L6N3ZS0O8 TEXT:"proposed"] Industrial Accelerator Act, unveiled in March. RATIONALE The Industrial Accelerator Act is part of broader EU efforts to help local industries compete with producers abroad who do not face Europe's strict regulations and higher energy prices. It is aimed in particular at reducing reliance on China, which dominates production of many green technologies, including most solar panel components. The EU law aims to use the huge financial firepower of its member countries' public procurement - worth more than €2 trillion ($2.29 trillion) or 14% of EU economic output - to shore up struggling domestic industries. WHAT WILL THE LAW DO? The proposal introduces local-content and low-carbon requirements for products bought through public procurement, public auctions or via subsidy schemes. It covers strategic sectors including steel, aluminium and cement, electric vehicles, batteries, solar and wind power, hydrogen technology and nuclear energy. It sets a specific requirement per technology, depending on whether the aim is to maintain an existing industry - like hydrogen electrolysers, where EU manufacturers currently lead the local market - or to pull back to Europe a small share of an industry which China dominates. For solar panels, the inverter plus the cells would need to be Europe-made within three years. Aluminium bought through public procurement would need to be 25% EU-made and low-carbon. Steel would not face EU-made requirements, but would need to be 25% low-carbon. Makers of electric vehicles bought through public procurement would have to ensure their vehicles are assembled in the EU, and that 70% of their components - excluding the battery - are EU-made, six months after the law takes effect. WHAT IS 'MADE IN EU'? A key point of contention is how to define "Made in EU". Under the proposal, goods from the 27 EU member states, plus Iceland, Liechtenstein, and Norway - which are part of the single market - are automatically included. Some non-EU countries could also be included if they provide reciprocal access to their public procurement or subsidy programmes. Eligibility would generally be limited to countries covered by WTO procurement rules or trade agreements with the bloc. That could pose problems for countries like close ally Canada, where a "buy Canadian" policy prioritises local firms over foreign ones. The Commission has yet to publish a list of qualifying countries. British carmakers' association SMMT said that excluding Britain would put shared investment and a €80 billion trading relationship at risk. The proposal includes exemptions where products are unavailable in Europe or where switching suppliers would raise costs significantly. RULES FOR FOREIGN INVESTORS The law would also impose conditions on foreign investments above 100 million euros in strategic sectors where the investor's home country accounts for at least 40% of global manufacturing capacity, a provision widely seen as targeting China. The criteria include the requirement that the foreign investor cannot hold a majority stake in an EU company, must employ mostly European workers, and must license its intellectual property to benefit the EU investment. NEXT STEPS EU governments and the European Parliament must agree a final text, with approval expected next year. France is seeking stricter limits on which non-EU countries the law lets in, while Sweden and the Czech Republic have opposed strict rules, warning they could deter investment and raise prices. Germany has also struck a cautious tone, with Chancellor Friedrich Merz previously saying that sole European preference rules should be a "last resort". Industries are also pushing for changes. Some sectors that have been left out, including [USN:L6N3ZL12S TEXT:"steel manufacturers"], want "Made in EU" rules for their sector. Carmakers have been less enthusiastic, concerned that their sprawling global supply chains could be upended. ($1 = 0.8728 euros)

item.title: Unionsfraktion stellt sich hinter Merz - und fordert rasche Umsetzung Reformen
item.description: Die CDU/CSU-Bundestagsfraktion hat sich am Dienstag hinter Kanzler Friedrich Merz gestellt und sich für die rasche Umsetzung der mit der SPD verabredeten Reformpakete ausgesprochen. Die Reformen müssten jetzt so schnell wie möglich umgesetzt werden, sagte Fraktionschef Thorsten Frei (CDU) in der Debatte nach Teilnehmerangaben. Er mahnte aber auch, dass gerade die Union nach den bitteren Wahlniederlagen in den Landtagswahlen einen "Beitrag zur Stabilisierung" der Koalition leisten müsse. Sowohl CDU-Chef Merz als auch Digitalminister Karsten Wildberger hielten nach Teilnehmerangaben kämpferische Reden.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die CDU/CSU-Bundestagsfraktion hat sich am Dienstag hinter Kanzler Friedrich Merz gestellt und sich für die rasche Umsetzung der mit der SPD verabredeten Reformpakete ausgesprochen. Die Reformen müssten jetzt so schnell wie möglich umgesetzt werden, sagte Fraktionschef Thorsten Frei (CDU) in der Debatte nach Teilnehmerangaben. Er mahnte aber auch, dass gerade die Union nach den bitteren Wahlniederlagen in den Landtagswahlen einen "Beitrag zur Stabilisierung" der Koalition leisten müsse. Sowohl CDU-Chef Merz als auch Digitalminister Karsten Wildberger hielten nach Teilnehmerangaben kämpferische Reden. Die Debatte in der Fraktion war nach den herben Niederlagen der CDU in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern und Berlin mit Spannung erwartet worden. Denn in den vergangenen Wochen hatte es auch Kritik am Führungsstil und der Politik von Merz von Abgeordneten gegeben, die zudem teilweise gedroht hatten, bei schwarz-roten Gesetzesvorhaben nicht mitstimmen zu wollen. Allerdings hatten sich vergangene Woche dann CSU-Chef Markus Söder und acht CDU-Ministerpräsidenten hinter den Kanzler gestellt und vor weiteren Personaldiskussionen gewarnt. Am Dienstag hatten Frei, CSU-Landesgruppenchef Alexander Hoffmann und die neue Parlamentarische Geschäftsführerin der CDU/CSU-Bundestagsfraktion, Catarina dos Santos-Wintz, übereinstimmend betont, dass die Fraktion hinter Merz stehe. In der zweieinhalbstündigen Debatte bekam etwa der frühere Fraktionschef Ralph Brinkhaus (CDU) stärkeren Applaus, als er vor einer existenziellen Krise der CDU nach den Wahlschlappen warnte. Digitalminister Wildberger, der nicht Teil der Fraktion ist, habe die Abgeordneten in einer eindringlichen Rede gemahnt, dass für ihn die CDU die einzige Kraft sei, die einen Ausgleich zwischen verschiedenen Kräften und Interessen suche und schon deshalb Volkspartei sei. Man dürfe sich den angeblichen Niedergang nicht einreden lassen und müsse sich auf die Reformarbeit konzentrieren. MERZ UND UNION POCHEN AUF DURCHSETZUNG REFORMEN Der Kanzler hatte in seiner auch selbstkritisch beschriebenen Rede darauf bestanden, dass die Koalition nun im Herbst die vereinbarten Projekte wie die Renten- und Pflegereform umsetzen müsse. Zudem müssten die Verteidigungsausgaben perspektivisch wieder in den Haushalt überführt werden. Wenn die Abgeordneten ein größeres Volumen der Entlastung bei der Steuerreform wollten, müssten sie Vorschläge machen, wo gleichzeitig Ausgaben gekürzt werden könnten, habe er gesagt. Für den Abend sind im Kanzleramt unter anderem Gespräche von Kanzleramtschefin Nina Warken, Arbeitsministerin Bärbel Bas (SPD), Gesundheitsminister Carsten Linnemann (CDU) und den Sherpas der schwarz-roten Koalition geplant. Dabei solle es um die Abstimmung der anstehenden Pflege- und Rentenreform gehen. "Der Bundeskanzler hat unsere Unterstützung und ja, ich bin davon überzeugt, dass wir gemeinsam mit der SPD die verabredeten Reformvorhaben auch tatsächlich zügig durchsetzen können", hatte Frei schon vor der Fraktionssitzung gesagt. Führende SPD-Politiker hatten nach den Wahlen dagegen am Sonntag auf Korrekturen am Kurs der Regierung gepocht. CSU-Landesgruppenchef Hoffmann bezeichnete die Reformprojekte als "unumstößlich". Er verwies aber wie Frei darauf, dass ohnehin bereits Korrekturen verabredet seien. "Wir müssen die Rente reformieren, und es ist auch klar, dass die Rente mit 63, also nach 45 Beitragsjahren, nicht so bleiben kann." Es gebe mit der SPD aber bereits eine Vereinbarung über eine Härtefallregelung. Dies hatte auch der Parlamentarische Geschäftsführer der SPD-Bundestagsfraktion, Dirk Wiese, betont. Er sehe dabei keine Differenzen mit SPD-Chef Lars Klingbeil, mit dem er gesprochen habe, sagte Hoffmann. Frei sprach von "einigen Detailfragen, die noch zu klären sind". Die Rentenreform solle den Bundestag aber zügig und "in einem Rutsch" passieren. "Das darf man nicht in unterschiedliche Pakete aufteilen."

item.title: Venezolano al que dispararon agentes del ICE volvió al hospital para tratamiento contra la parálisis: abogada
item.description: El venezolano que pasó la noche del domingo en un centro de detención del ICE con una bala incrustada en la espalda tras recibir un disparo de un agente federal de inmigración en Austin, Texas, fue trasladado de nuevo a un hospital, según declaró su abogada el lunes por la noche.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El venezolano que pasó la noche del domingo en un centro de detención del ICE con una bala incrustada en la espalda tras recibir un disparo de un agente federal de inmigración en Austin, Texas, fue trasladado de nuevo a un hospital, según declaró su abogada el lunes por la noche. "Por fin he recibido la noticia de que Wilber ha sido trasladado de nuevo a otro hospital para recibir tratamiento por la parálisis que sufre en el lado izquierdo", escribió Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch, la abogada de Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez, en sus redes sociales. Lincoln-Goldfinch añadió que iría a visitarlo a primera hora del martes por la mañana. Durante una rueda de prensa el lunes, Lincoln-Goldfinch presentó a un hombre que llamó por teléfono identificándose como Garcés Pérez, quien afirmó que el domingo había sido trasladado a un centro de tramitación del ICE situado a unas 130 millas al suroeste de Austin, tras pasar unas horas en el hospital después del tiroteo. En la llamada del lunes el hombre, de 28 años, dijo que seguía sangrando y que no estaba recibiendo la atención médica adecuada. "No estoy bien", dijo, y añadió que tenía que dormir en el suelo del centro de detención. Contó que el domingo había salido a trabajar como repartidor de comida para DoorDash cuando su coche fue embestido lateralmente por los agentes, quienes, según él, no se identificaron ni encendieron ningún tipo de luz ni sirena. Garcés Pérez afirmó que un agente le disparó mientras aún estaba en su coche y que no hubo ninguna persecución a pie. La policía de Austin declaró el domingo que había huido de los agentes. El Departamento de Seguridad Nacional no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios ni el lunes ni el martes. El domingo, el DHS publicó un comunicado escrito en el que afirmaba que Pérez se encontraba en Estados Unidos de forma ilegal y que tenía una orden definitiva de expulsión del país. No proporcionaron detalles sobre las circunstancias del tiroteo.

item.title: EEUU dice que el nuevo sistema de control del tráfico aéreo no sufrirá interrupciones
item.description: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos está desarrollando un sistema de control del tráfico aéreo moderno y resistente que no sufrirá interrupciones masivas de las telecomunicaciones como la que afectó a miles de vuelos esta semana, dijo el martes el secretario de Transporte, Sean Duffy.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos está desarrollando un sistema de control del tráfico aéreo moderno y resistente que no sufrirá interrupciones masivas de las telecomunicaciones como la que afectó a miles de vuelos esta semana, dijo el martes el secretario de Transporte, Sean Duffy. "Esto no volverá a ocurrir en el futuro con la nueva arquitectura. No habrá puntos de fallo únicos o dobles. Contamos con múltiples rutas para llevar las telecomunicaciones a todas nuestras instalaciones", explicó Duffy en el programa "Fox and Friends" de Fox News. El lunes, unos 9.500 vuelos en Estados Unidos sufrieron retrasos o fueron cancelados tras el fallo de un conmutador de telecomunicaciones y el corte accidental de un cable de fibra óptica, lo que obligó a la Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA) a suspender durante horas los vuelos con destino a los aeropuertos de Nueva York, Filadelfia, Boston y Washington. El martes, las operaciones se desarrollaban en gran medida con normalidad. El lunes se cancelaron más de 600 vuelos en Newark Liberty, más de la mitad de ese aeropuerto, un importante centro de de United Airlines (UAL.O) . A las 10:30 hora local se habían cancelado unos 60 vuelos y otros 70 sufrían retrasos. El incidente puso de manifiesto la fragilidad del anticuado sistema de control del tráfico aéreo de Estados Unidos. El año pasado, el Congreso destinó 12.500 millones de dólares a su modernización. El costo de las mejoras en las telecomunicaciones ha subido de 4.750 millones a 5.910 millones de dólares, según un informe gubernamental de la semana pasada. El administrador de la FAA, Bryan Bedford, dijo que los cables de cobre obsoletos deben estar sustituidos por completo para septiembre de 2027.

item.title: Wacker Chemie wirft weiteres Siltronic-Aktienpaket auf den Markt
item.description: Der Münchner Chemiekonzern Wacker Chemie trennt sich von einem weiteren Aktienpaket der ehemaligen Tochter Siltronic und dürfte damit seine Position als größter Anteilseigner des Wafer-Herstellers verlieren. Wacker will über Nacht 2,2 Millionen Siltronic-Aktien bei institutionellen Investoren platzieren und seine Beteiligung dadurch von bisher 21,67 Prozent auf knapp 15 Prozent reduzieren, wie das Unternehmen am Dienstagabend mitteilte. Den Auftrag dafür haben die Bank of America (BofA Securities) und die Deutsche Bank.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Münchner Chemiekonzern Wacker Chemie (WCHG.DE) trennt sich von einem weiteren Aktienpaket der ehemaligen Tochter Siltronic (WAFGn.DE) und dürfte damit seine Position als größter Anteilseigner des Wafer-Herstellers verlieren. Wacker will über Nacht 2,2 Millionen Siltronic-Aktien bei institutionellen Investoren platzieren und seine Beteiligung dadurch von bisher 21,67 Prozent auf knapp 15 Prozent reduzieren, wie das Unternehmen am Dienstagabend mitteilte. Den Auftrag dafür haben die Bank of America (BofA Securities) und die Deutsche Bank. Der Verkauf könnte zum Xetra-Schlusskurs von 82,75 Euro einen Erlös von rund 182 Millionen Euro bringen, allerdings werden Aktien bei solchen Platzierungen meist mit einem Abschlag von drei bis sieben Prozent verkauft. Im Frankfurter Parketthandel lagen Siltronic am Abend bei 81,60 Euro. Siltronic hatte zuletzt an der Börse vom KI-Boom profitiert. Anleger setzen darauf, dass für die neuen Rechenzentren für die Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) mehr Chips benötigt werden, für die Siltronic in Form von Siliziumscheiben die Grundlage schafft. Wacker Chemie hatte bereits Ende Mai die Gelegenheit genutzt, um seine Beteiligung von 31 auf knapp 24 Prozent zu reduzieren. Mit einer Kapitalerhöhung wurde der Anteil weiter verwässert. Die niederländische Beteiligungsgesellschaft HAL Trust (HLAN.AS) , die bereits zuvor 15,1 Prozent an Siltronic gehalten hatte, hatte sich an der Kapitalerhöhung dem Unternehmen zufolge "mit einer bedeutenden Order beteiligt" und dürfte mit der neuen Wacker-Platzierung zum größten Aktionär werden.

item.title: Meta testa "concierge humano" para seu novo agente pessoal de IA Muse
item.description: A Meta vem testando um serviço de “concierge humano” para seu novo assistente pessoal de IA, o Muse, que envolve a participação discreta de funcionários terceirizados na realização de algumas das ligações telefônicas feitas por meio do agente digital, segundo publicações internas da empresa vistas pela Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Katie Paul
item.content:encoded: A Meta (META.O) vem testando um serviço de “concierge humano” para seu novo assistente pessoal de IA, o Muse, que envolve a participação discreta de funcionários terceirizados na realização de algumas das ligações telefônicas feitas por meio do agente digital, segundo publicações internas da empresa vistas pela Reuters. A dona do Facebook e do Instagram informou os funcionários sobre o teste na semana passada, pouco depois de lançar publicamente um recurso de chamadas telefônicas para o Muse, de acordo com uma dessas publicações. Alguns funcionários levantaram preocupações relacionadas à privacidade, alertando que a participação de agentes humanos nas ligações poderia resultar no compartilhamento involuntário de informações sensíveis com terceirizados que trabalham em centrais de atendimento. Questionado sobre o recurso, um porta-voz da Meta afirmou que a reação dos funcionários foi “amplamente positiva” e que o objetivo do teste era “obter feedback para que possamos implementar salvaguardas de segurança e privacidade e aprimorar os recursos antes de disponibilizá-los publicamente”. “Estamos trabalhando com comerciantes para continuar aprimorando esse potencial recurso de chamadas e só o lançaremos quando estiver pronto e com as devidas divulgações”, disse o porta-voz, Daniel Roberts. (Reportagem de Katie Paul, em Nova York)

item.title: Bancos alertam que bots de compras baseados em IA aumentam riscos de golpes
item.description: O uso de agentes de inteligência artificial para compras online pode aumentar o risco de golpes, fraudes e violações de privacidade de dados, afirmaram nesta terça-feira bancos como NatWest e Bank of America ao estabelecerem princípios para o desenvolvimento da tecnologia.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Howcroft
item.content:encoded: O uso de agentes de inteligência artificial para compras online pode aumentar o risco de golpes, fraudes e violações de privacidade de dados, afirmaram nesta terça-feira bancos como NatWest (NWG.L) e Bank of America (BAC.N) ao estabelecerem princípios para o desenvolvimento da tecnologia. Empresas de tecnologia, como OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (GOOGL.O) e Meta (META.O) estão promovendo cada vez mais os chatbots de IA como ferramentas de compra, vislumbrando um futuro em que os consumidores usem agentes de IA para selecionarem produtos e fazerem compras em seu nome. Enquanto isso, os varejistas correm para influenciar as recomendações dos chatbots. A varejista britânica John Lewis informou em setembro que a participação de buscas criadas por agentes de IA subiram de 0,3% no ano anterior para 2,5%, com a tendência se acelerando. O grupo de bancos, que também inclui ING (INGA.AS) , ASB Bank (ABB030.NZ) , da Nova Zelândia; Capital One (COF.N) e Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA.AX) , afirmou em um relatório que os clientes estão entusiasmados com o potencial do comércio por agentes e ansiosos para adotá-lo. No entanto, eles alertaram que a tecnologia está avançando mais rapidamente do que os padrões de segurança do setor e do consumidor. “Os consumidores não têm certeza se a IA agirá em seu interesse”, afirma o relatório. “Eles temem que os agentes de IA possam comprar o produto errado ou gastar demais, ou, pior ainda, perder seu dinheiro em golpes e fraudes. Não têm certeza se estarão protegidos nem a quem recorrerão caso algo dê errado.” O relatório destaca riscos, incluindo a possibilidade de agentes de IA solicitarem dados de cartão dos clientes e inseri-los diretamente em sites, ou direcionarem os usuários para formas de pagamento que ofereçam proteções mais fracas. Os bancos planejam discutir uma série de propostas com os formuladores de políticas, incluindo a exigência de divulgação quando um agente de IA estiver envolvido em uma transação, maior transparência sobre como os agentes de IA tomam decisões e medidas de segurança para proteger os dados dos clientes. Consumidores e comerciantes também devem ter liberdade para escolher quais serviços de comércio eletrônico baseados em IA utilizarão, enquanto os diferentes sistemas devem ser interoperáveis, defende o relatório.

item.title: Trump dice que EE.UU. construirá dos bases militares en Groenlandia para “defender el continente”
item.description: El acuerdo con Dinamarca y Groenlandia ampliará el papel militar de Washington en la isla, aunque esta seguirá bajo soberanía danesa. Aún no se conocen todos los detalles.
item.dc:creator: Sanne Wass
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Donald Trump afirmó que Estados Unidos comenzará a construir dos “bases militares de gran envergadura” en Groenlandia una vez que se firme, a lo largo del martes, un acuerdo de seguridad con Dinamarca y Groenlandia. El acuerdo otorgará a EE.UU. “el control permanente sobre la seguridad y todas las demás necesidades en ese territorio”, afirmó Trump en su intervención ante la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York, antes de la ceremonia de firma. “Tendremos plena capacidad para hacer lo que sea necesario para defender el continente americano, así como Europa y otros lugares”, afirmó el presidente. “Comenzaremos de inmediato el proceso de establecer una importante presencia militar en los emplazamientos adecuados”. Ver más: ABC del acuerdo entre EE.UU., Dinamarca y Groenlandia: qué gana Trump y qué cambia en la isla Está previsto que el presidente de EE.UU. firme el acuerdo junto a la primera ministra danesa, Mette Frederiksen, y al líder de Groenlandia, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, al margen de la reunión anual de las Naciones Unidas, poco después de su discurso del martes. La firma pondrá fin a meses de negociaciones destinadas a zanjar una disputa sobre el territorio danés semiautónomo que, en enero, se convirtió en una grave crisis diplomática entre los miembros de la Organización del Tratado del Atlántico Norte. El enfrentamiento se desencadenó a raíz de las repetidas amenazas de Trump, desde que asumió el cargo, de anexionar Groenlandia o tomar el control de la isla. Trump también elogió en su discurso a Dinamarca como un “país increíble y hermoso”, y afirmó que ambas partes habían “establecido realmente un vínculo” a través de las negociaciones. El acuerdo tiene por objeto ampliar el papel militar de Washington en Groenlandia, aunque dejará a Groenlandia bajo la soberanía danesa, afirmó Frederiksen el lunes, calificándolo de “un buen acuerdo” que beneficia a todas las partes. Aún no se han dado a conocer todos los detalles. Ver más: El presidente Trump dice que alcanzó un acuerdo con Dinamarca sobre la seguridad de Groenlandia “No estamos cediendo la soberanía, y puedo garantizar que nunca lo haré como primera ministra danesa”, declaró a las cadenas de televisión locales. “Es perfectamente posible mantener la soberanía al tiempo que se establece una cooperación más estrecha en materia de seguridad y defensa”. Trump anunció el viernes que se había alcanzado un acuerdo y afirmó en las redes sociales que este otorgaría a EE.UU. “control permanente sobre la seguridad” en Groenlandia, lo que incluiría conceder a Washington voz y voto sobre la actividad militar extranjera y las inversiones sensibles, así como ampliar su presencia militar en la isla. El acuerdo se produce tras una serie de reveses para Trump, entre los que se incluyen los prolongados combates en Medio Oriente, la falta de avances para poner fin a la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania y las persistentes presiones del coste de la vida para los votantes estadounidenses de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura. Desde que volvió al cargo el año pasado, Trump ha presionado repetidamente a Dinamarca, un aliado de la OTAN, para que ceda Groenlandia. Las tensiones se recrudecieron en enero después de que se negara a descartar una acción militar, lo que llevó a Dinamarca y a otros aliados de la OTAN a enviar tropas a la isla. Ver más: Canadá y países nórdicos estrechan lazos en el Ártico y respaldan soberanía de Groenlandia Aunque el despliegue se presentó públicamente como un ejercicio, Copenhague envió fuerzas con munición real que estaban preparadas para volar las pistas del aeropuerto con el fin de impedir el aterrizaje de las tropas estadounidenses si Trump intentaba apoderarse de Groenlandia por la fuerza, según un informe de la DR. El enfrentamiento comenzó a aliviarse después de que Trump mantuviera conversaciones con el secretario general de la OTAN, Mark Rutte, en el Foro Económico Mundial de Davos, en Suiza. Allí, ambos acordaron las líneas generales de un acuerdo marco relativo a Groenlandia. Desde entonces, altos funcionarios de Dinamarca, Groenlandia y EE.UU. han mantenido conversaciones en un grupo de trabajo creado para abordar la disputa. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Dinamarca, Lars Løkke Rasmussen, calificó este martes este periodo como un “capítulo destructivo” en las relaciones transatlánticas y afirmó en un vídeo publicado en las redes sociales que espera que el acuerdo pueda ahora ponerle fin. -Con la colaboración de Tyler Clifford, Ben Sills y Kate Seaman. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Peso mexicano retrocede por expectativas sobre Banxico, bolsa sube
item.description: El peso mexicano retrocedía el martes, presionado por la perspectiva de que Banco de México mantendrá sin cambios su tasa clave en su decisión del jueves, pese al incremento del costo de los créditos de la Reserva Federal la semana pasada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano retrocedía el martes, presionado por la perspectiva de que [USN:L6N45D0SW TEXT:"Banco de México"] mantendrá sin cambios su tasa clave en su decisión del jueves, pese al incremento del costo de los créditos de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] la semana pasada. Los mercados, además, vigilaban una disminución de los [USN:L6N45E0F0 TEXT:"precios del petróleo"], ante expectativas de una mayor oferta desde el Golfo Pérsico y señales de una posible reapertura del [USN:L6N45E0KN TEXT:"estrecho de Ormuz"], una vía estratégica para el transporte mundial de crudo. * La moneda local MXN= cotizaba en 17.2939 unidades por dólar, con una depreciación de un 0.45%, a medida que la [USN:L6N45E0QE TEXT:"divisa estadounisense"] registraba fuertes oscilaciones tras alcanzar un máximo de casi dos meses. * Los [USN:L6N45E0F0 TEXT:"precios del petróleo"], a su vez, caían luego de que Irán afirmó que podría reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz al tráfico marítimo del golfo Pérsico en cuestión de días si Estados Unidos reduce su presión militar. * A su vez, el presidente estadounidense [USN:L1N45E0KU TEXT:"Donald Trump"] declaró ante la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas que creía que su país llegaría a un acuerdo con Irán justo después de que se celebren las elecciones de mitad de legislatura en noviembre. * La bolsa mexicana en cambio apuntaba a su segunda sesión de ganancias, luego de haber tocado su nivel más bajo en lo que va del año. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) ascendía un 0.39%, a 63,783.40 puntos, siguiendo un sólido desempeño de [USN:L6N45E0PV TEXT:"Wall Street"]. * Los títulos del productor de pan Grupo Bimbo (BIMBOA.MX) encabezaban las alzas, con un 2.28% más a 55.68 pesos. Les seguían los papeles del minero Grupo México (GMEXICOB.MX) , que avanzaban un 2.19% a 219.15 pesos. * En el mercado de deuda está previsto que más tarde el banco central divulgue los resultados de su subasta semanal de valores gubernamentales, en la que busca colocar 50,000 millones de pesos (2,891 millones de dólares) en Certificados de la Tesorería (Cetes).

item.title: Real Madrid call for new LaLiga president following Tebas statements
item.description: Real Madrid want a new LaLiga president in light of what they called "intolerable" comments from incumbent Javier Tebas, who said earlier on Tuesday that claims of officiating bias against the club belonged to "another galaxy".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Real Madrid want a new LaLiga president in light of what they called "intolerable" comments from incumbent Javier Tebas, who said earlier on Tuesday that claims of officiating bias against the club belonged to "another galaxy". After [USN:L6N45C064 TEXT:"losing 2-1 to Atletico"] Madrid on Sunday, Real headlined the match report on their website: 'Terrible refereeing decides the derby'. Real were furious that Atletico defender Cristian Romero was not sent off for a stamp on Jude Bellingham and also complained about a challenge by Lee Kang-in on Federico Valverde. [USN:L6N45C07G TEXT:"Real manager Jose Mourinho"] aimed sharp criticism at referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias and those who appointed him. The Portuguese coach said his side could win the title "if they let us compete on a level playing field." Real are currently in fourth place, six points behind reigning champions Barcelona after seven matches. Tebas had said on Monday that the narrative being pushed by Real was a smokescreen to cover up shortcomings on the pitch. "Claiming that referees are told to go against Real Madrid is living in another galaxy," Tebas said on social media. "It's more comfortable to point to a conspiracy than to explain what's happening on the pitch." Real responded with a statement on their website condemning Tebas' declarations and saying LaLiga needed new leadership. "Our club considers it intolerable that the president of LaLiga uses his institutional position to continue discrediting and attacking Real Madrid," said the statement. "Given this inappropriate and persistent behaviour, we believe that the professional football competition in Spain urgently needs a leader capable of managing it and realising its full potential with the fundamental duty of neutrality." Reuters has asked LaLiga for comment. Tebas, a self-proclaimed Real Madrid fan, has been in charge of LaLiga since 2013. In December 2023, he ran unopposed for a fourth term and his current mandate lasts until 2027. During his presidency, Tebas has regularly been vocal on disagreements with Real Madrid, while LaLiga and the club have also clashed in the courtroom in recent years. Real filed to annul decisions made by LaLiga in 2022 for infringing their participation rights as they were excluded from the Control Body for the management of the league's audiovisual rights. In June, Spain's Supreme Court ruled in Real's favour.

item.title: Red Sox reach deals with manager Chad Tracy, top executive Craig Breslow
item.description: The Boston Red Sox dropped the interim tag on Tuesday and named Chad Tracy as the 49th manager in franchise history.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Boston Red Sox dropped the interim tag on Tuesday and named Chad Tracy as the 49th manager in franchise history. Tracy agreed to a three-year contract that will extend through the 2029 season with a club option in 2030. Also on Tuesday, the Red Sox exercised their 2029 and 2030 contract options on Craig Breslow, the team's chief baseball officer. No financial terms were released. "Craig and Chad are two exceptionally talented leaders who have earned these opportunities in very different ways," Red Sox president and CEO Sam Kennedy said in a statement. "Over the last three years, we have watched Craig bring clarity, discipline, and conviction to the work of building our baseball operation. Chad was asked to step into a difficult situation with little notice, but the trust he immediately commanded at the major league level was earned through years of work across our organization. "What this team has accomplished over the past several months has been historic. Results matter greatly in this business, but so do judgment, character, and the ability to bring out the best in others. Craig and Chad have demonstrated all of those qualities, and they have earned our confidence in leading us forward." Breslow, 46, was named to his position on Oct. 25, 2023. The Red Sox have posted a 254-226 record under his watch. Tracy, 41, was named the interim manager on April 26, taking over a team that owned a 10-17 record under former manager Alex Cora. They have qualified for a wild-card berth in the American League playoffs and have an 84-72 record heading into the final six games of the season. Boston's success under Tracy was highlighted by a 27-3 mark from July 3-Aug. 7 that served as the best 30-game span in franchise history. --Field Level Media

item.description: NEW YORK, Sept 22 : Meta has been testing a “human concierge” for its new personal AI assistant, Muse, which entails having human contractors quietly handle some of the phone calls placed via the digital agent, according to internal company posts seen by Reuters.The Facebook and Instagram owner told emplo
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Exclusive-Meta testing a 'human concierge' for its new personal AI agent Muse

FILE PHOTO: People are seen behind a logo of Meta Platforms, during a conference in Mumbai, India, September 20, 2023. REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas/File Photo

NEW YORK, Sept 22 : Meta has been testing a “human concierge” for its new personal AI assistant, Muse, which entails having human contractors quietly handle some of the phone calls placed via the digital agent, according to internal company posts seen by Reuters. The Facebook and Instagram owner told employees about the test last week, shortly after the company publicly launched a phone calling feature for Muse. Some employees have raised privacy concerns about human agents handling the calls, warning that it could result in sensitive information being shared unintentionally with contractors in call centers, the posts showed. Asked about the feature, a Meta spokesperson said the response from employees has been "overwhelmingly positive" and that the purpose of the test was to "get feedback so we can implement safety and privacy protections and improve features before we release them publicly."

"We're working with merchants to continue improving this potential calling feature, and will only roll it out when it's ready and with the proper disclosures," said the spokesperson, Daniel Roberts. MUSE TOPS US DOWNLOAD CHARTS    Meta's Muse agent has topped US app download charts in the two weeks since its debut, with more than 2.5 million downloads, according to data provided by market intelligence firm Sensor Tower. The centerpiece of CEO Mark Zuckerberg's plan to supply "personal superintelligence" to the billions of people who use Meta's services daily, the AI bot can autonomously perform tasks like sending emails, shopping and booking travel on a person's behalf. Meta heavily emphasized the AI assistant's safety protections during its launch, telling would-be users that each agent would have its own secure “virtual machine,” or a dedicated computer in the cloud designed to keep people’s sessions isolated, and would keep sensitive information like passwords in separate secure storage. With the phone calling feature, a Muse user can tell the agent to dial phone numbers for US businesses and talk with people on the other end to handle errands like booking haircuts, checking whether a store has an item in stock and getting quotes from different contractors. After the call, the agent provides a summary and transcript of how the exchange played out in the Muse app. Meta began having employees test out, or “dogfood,” the phone calling capability in August and gradually started rolling it out to Muse users in the days after the app’s debut, the internal posts showed. It enabled the human concierge feature, also referred to as “human agent calls,” for half of Meta’s employees last week, according to the post announcing the feature to employees. “Muse is now able to hand requests to a trained agent, who places the call and works it through,” the post said. Employees who did not want to be included could join an opt-out group, according to the post.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Trump dice que la libertad llegará a Cuba, en discurso ante la ONU
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump dijo que Cuba era un Estado fallido y que la libertad llegaría a la isla gobernada por los comunistas en un discurso pronunciado el martes ante la ONU, en el que abogó por una mayor implicación de Estados Unidos en la región.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump dijo que Cuba era un Estado fallido y que la libertad llegaría a la isla gobernada por los comunistas en un discurso pronunciado el martes ante la ONU, en el que abogó por una mayor implicación de Estados Unidos en la región. "Mi Gobierno también busca un cambio fundamental en la situación de Cuba, donde el régimen comunista se encuentra bajo una gran presión -la mayor a la que se ha visto sometido jamás-. Es un Estado absolutamente fallido, está fracasando como nunca antes y caerá", dijo Trump en su discurso ante la Asamblea General de la ONU. "El comunismo nunca llegará a Estados Unidos, pero la libertad sí llegará a Cuba". La delegación cubana abandonó la sala de la Asamblea General de la ONU durante la intervención de Trump. Estados Unidos ha mantenido por más de 60 años un embargo comercial contra Cuba y el gobierno de Trump ha intensificado la presión sobre la isla, controlada por el Partido Comunista, tras recurrir al ejército en enero para derrocar al presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Fight for scale
item.description: Greetings from London! Welcome to the first edition of the new Auto File for subscribers. We’ll take you deeper into the stories shaping the automotive industry, with exclusive materials and expert insights.
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey
item.content:encoded: Greetings from London! Welcome to the first edition of the new Auto File for subscribers. We’ll take you deeper into the stories shaping the automotive industry, with exclusive materials and expert insights. And we’re interested in your perspective: Which issues are going to shape the future of the automotive industry? What questions are on your mind? Write to me at autofile@thomsonreuters.com and we’ll try to tackle these issues in upcoming editions. Let’s get into it: The auto headlines have come thick and fast in the last week, but today we’ll consider the question of scale. The stories of three very different brands - [USN:L8N45319B TEXT:"Seat"], [USN:L1N4570QN TEXT:"McLaren"] and [USN:L1N45A0D2 TEXT:"Ceer"] – illustrate how this plays a vital role in ensuring a brand’s survival. Seat is a major mainstream brand with a bleak future as it loses scale and its owner Volkswagen figures out what to keep after its turnaround, while McLaren and Ceer are minnows pursuing scale in different ways. Whether it’s Chinese automakers taking market share from legacy automakers, or startups trying to sell enough cars to bring down costs and lift profits, the fight for scale is back in focus across the industry and will be for the foreseeable future. Read below to see how executives at these companies are seeking to build or preserve scale and avoid falling into obscurity. Which brings us to today’s Auto File… [USN:L1N4570QN TEXT:"Scaling"] [USN:L1N45A0D2 TEXT:"up"] or [USN:L8N45319B TEXT:"down"] VW’s [USN:L8N45B02A TEXT:"pain continues"] GM misses out on [USN:L6N4570VU TEXT:"hybrids"] SCALING NEW HEIGHTS One of the enduring themes of this decade has been the failure of EV startups to scale up. Companies like Arrival and Lordstown raised billions from investors who wanted the next Tesla – even though most had no revenue or even working prototypes. Most of those same companies went bust as investors balked at letting startups burn sacks of cash with little prospect of getting to scale. Jim DeLuca, CEO of Saudi EV startup Ceer has a deep-pocketed backer in the country’s sovereign wealth fund, but he told me ahead of the [USN:L1N45A0D2 TEXT:"launch of the company’s first two electric models"] that he has learned from mistakes of other firms. First, DeLuca stressed that the two futuristic models – the sedan in particular reminds me of the cars in sci-fi thriller “Tron” – are real pre-production cars that will start deliveries in the first quarter, not just ideas in a PowerPoint. After his experience as CEO of Vietnamese EV maker VinFast – which burned through billions in an aggressive expansion plan and is now [USN:L6N41R0QY TEXT:"restructuring"] – DeLuca stresses that Ceer will instead scale up methodically in Saudi Arabia then neighboring countries. Chinese automakers are piling into the Middle East, so it remains to be seen if Ceer can make it. The company has a determined backer as Saudi Arabia has long wanted a viable auto industry of its own. But with a huge global fight for market share underway, it’s not an easy market to launch a new brand into. A FIRST-EVER SUV FOR MCLAREN Life has also not been easy for McLaren, which has been lossmaking for years. But after a painful restructuring under a new owner – Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund L’IMAD – the UK sportscar maker is [USN:L1N4570QN TEXT:"expanding and investing"] in a new factory. That will include biting the bullet and launching its first-ever SUV – a move that has been a singular moneymaker for luxury rivals Ferrari, Lamborghini and Bentley. Part of McLaren’s problem has always been that a few thousand cars a year has not provided enough scale while the company has produced more cars than customers want – which brings discounts and weak resale values. Chief Operating Officer Michael Straughan told me that McLaren needs growth to spread its costs and get better terms from suppliers. The only way to do that is to launch more models like the SUV to bring in more customers. LAST BREATH AT SEAT? Sadly, lack of customers has been [USN:L8N45319B TEXT:"Seat’s problem"]. Founded in 1950 under Franco, Seat has struggled for years. Automakers loathe ditching old brands, not least of all because it doesn’t look good. But Volkswagen has telegraphed pretty clearly that Seat’s days are numbered. The brand has had no all-new models since 2020 and has not been allocated an EV model because it’s not profitable – the kiss of death on a continent gradually going electric. The last round of brands to die was around 15 years ago and included Pontiac, Saturn and Mercury. With the global fight for market share, you won’t have to wait that long for the next round. Recommended reading: Chinese automakers scour Europe for [USN:L8N4581FT TEXT:"old factories"] How Trump’s EV attacks hurt US auto revival [USN:L4N45914D TEXT:"Chinese car executives"] going with Xi to US? FRESH VW PAIN Almost four years ago to the day, Porsche had a blockbuster stock market listing where the luxury carmaker looked untouchable as the jewel in Volkswagen’s crown. Today, not so much. Porsche’s dismal performance in China and some expensive missteps into EVs have placed it [USN:L8N45B02A TEXT:"front and centre"] of Volkswagen’s broader problems as the sprawling German car group tries to turn its fortunes around. Much of the [USN:FWN45A0AR TEXT:"$11.5 billion"] in one-off costs Volkswagen spelled out in a profit warning on Friday come down to Porsche’s dire state. Volkswagen has promised to [USN:L8N45D0D9 TEXT:"ramp up"] its restructuring efforts. But the profit warning came just weeks after the company’s supervisory board approved a turnaround plan, leaving some investors wondering whether more bad news is coming. GM LACKS HYBRIDS The last few years have been hard for traditional automakers when it comes to making product decisions. For decades all they had to do was show up with an “all-new” car that boasted incremental improvements and other than some notable failures – the Edsel comes to mind – they generally hit their mark. But with high expectations early this decade of an electrifying world, some automakers bet too heavily on electric and were left hanging by a lack of demand – and in the US case by the Trump administration’s active dismantling of state support for the new technology. As Reuters reporter Kalea Hall reports, General Motors is one of those automakers that bet big on EVs and is now paying the price. You can read all about it [USN:L6N4570VU TEXT:"here"]. GM is sitting out [USN:L6N41K18Q TEXT:"a hybrid boom"].  Investors have cheered GM’s focus on gas-engine trucks and SUVs, which has [USN:L6N43M0XC TEXT:"fueled strong profits"]. But its US sales have declined this year, and some dealers say they are losing customers to rivals selling hybrids. FAST LAPS Major automakers, suppliers and dealers urged President Donald Trump to keep Chinese automakers [USN:L1N45A0LO TEXT:"out of the US market"], ahead of his meeting with China's President Xi Jinping. Volvo Cars will launch [USN:L6N4570Q1 TEXT:"13 new models"] between now and 2030 to double its market share as the Sweden-based automaker grapples with the fallout of U.S. tariffs and slumping sales in China. Chinese EV maker Xpeng plans to offer its technology to [USN:L4N4590C9 TEXT:"foreign automakers"] beyond partner Volkswagen as it seeks new revenue streams, according to two people familiar with the matter. Volvo Cars said [USN:TUC4PJ0RC TEXT:"Klaus Zellmer"] would become its president and chief executive officer within a year as it seeks to revive sales in an increasingly competitive market. Labor representatives at auto supplier Bosch demanded [USN:L8N4580EP TEXT:"EU-level"] political action to stem job losses in the industry by drawing up regulations to promote local production. Renault and Geely will make a new [USN:S0N44G00Z TEXT:"€319 million investment"] in Brazil, through their joint venture, reinforcing their industrial partnership in the largest Latin American market. Think your friend or colleague should know about us? Forward this newsletter to them. They can also subscribe here .

item.title: Petrobras iniciará perfuração de novos poços na Foz do Amazonas em janeiro
item.description: A Petrobras enviará uma sonda de perfuração à Bacia da Foz do Amazonas em janeiro para iniciar os trabalhos em três novos poços, disse nesta terça-feira a diretora de Engenharia, Tecnologia e Inovação da empresa, Renata Baruzzi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) enviará uma sonda de perfuração à Bacia da Foz do Amazonas em janeiro para iniciar os trabalhos em três novos poços, disse nesta terça-feira a diretora de Engenharia, Tecnologia e Inovação da empresa, Renata Baruzzi. A Petrobras recebeu recentemente autorização do Ibama, órgão ambiental brasileiro, para iniciar a perfuração. Os novos poços são essenciais para determinar a viabilidade comercial da descoberta de petróleo da Petrobras na região. (Reportagem de Fabio Teixeira)

item.title: グテレス国連事務総長、最後の総会演説 ＡＩ規制と国連改革訴え
item.description:
Antoni Slodkowski
[国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Antoni Slodkowski

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] - 国連のグテレス事務総長は２２日、国連総会での最後の演説で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の規制、戦争の終結、気候変動への取り組み、深刻化する世界的課題への対応に苦慮している国連機関の抜本的な改革を訴えた。グテレス氏の２期目の５年の任期は１２月３１日に満了する。

同氏は演説で、ＡＩリスクに対する世界的な監視を改めて呼び掛け。「この技術革命を主導する国々は、新たな安全上のリスクに関する情報を共有し、試験と評価で協力し、われわれ全員を守る共通のセーフガードに向けて取り組まねばならない」と述べた。

また、各国指導者に対し、「ＡＩの責任ある進展のための条件と、リスクに対処するために必要な追加のセーフガードを推進すること」、そして「信頼性と独立性を備えた監視に支えられた、多国間のＡＩリスク管理の枠組みに向けて取り組むこと」を要請した。

グテレス氏は長らくＡＩのグローバルガバナンスを推進してきた。国連は２０２３年、ＡＩに関する諮問機関を設立。メンバーにはＩＴ企業幹部、政府高官のほか、米国、ロシア、日本などの学識経験者が名を連ねている。

中東情勢を巡っては、「緊張緩和と対話」を呼び掛けた。「共にこの議場から明確なメッセージを送ろう。戦闘を止めなければならない。人道支援を届けなければならない。そして、国際法に従って航行の権利と自由を完全に回復させなければならない」とグテレス氏は述べた。

さらに、環境問題では、汚染者負担の原則を徹底すべきとも改めて訴えた。これは同氏が国連トップとして１０年間にわたり掲げてきた主張である。

グテレス氏はまた、国連組織内の機能不全にも言及した。約１３０人の各国首脳がニューヨークに集まったものの、中国の習近平国家主席をはじめ、南アフリカ、インド、ドイツの指導者らは出席を見送った。

さらに、トランプ米大統領らからは、国連システムが肥大化して機能していないとの批判が上がっているほか、米が複数の国連機関から脱退し拠出金も大幅に削減している。こうした中、グテレス氏は「集団行動のためのわれわれの仕組みは、ますます強い圧力にさらされている」と述べ、国際機関は「大部分がすでに過ぎ去った時代の権力の現実と利害を、依然として反映している」と指摘した。

今回の演説は、大国が国連を迂回（うかい）する動きを強め、米政府が拠出金を大幅に削減する中でも、グテレス氏が国連を紛争の仲介者、新興技術のガバナンスの場として位置付けようとしてきた１０年間の任期の総決算となった。

「１月１日、私はもはや事務総長ではないが、これだけは確信してほしい。私がどこにいようと、何をしていようと、平和は可能であるという信念を掲げ続ける」と強調した。「私は国連憲章の価値のために立ち上がり続け、決して、決して諦めない。ありがとう」と締めくくった。

item.title: Trump says freedom will be coming to Cuba in UN speech
item.description: President Donald Trump said Cuba was a failed state and freedom would be coming to the Communist-run island in an UN address Tuesday that touted greater US involvement in the region.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said Cuba was a failed state and freedom would be coming to the Communist-run island in an UN address Tuesday that touted greater US involvement in the region. "My administration is also seeking a fundamental change in the situation in Cuba, where the communist regime is under great pressure-the biggest pressure they've ever been under. It's an absolutely failed State, it's failing like never before, and it will fall," Trump said in his speech to the UN General Assembly. "Communism will never be coming to America, but freedom will be coming to Cuba." The Cuban delegation walked out of the UN General Assembly hall during Trump's remarks. The US has maintained a trade embargo on Cuba for more than 60 years and Trump's administration has been [USN:O8N42O02O TEXT:"stepping up pressure"] on Communist-controlled Cuba, after using the military in January to remove Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro. Trump has called Cuba a failed nation in the past, including in June, when he said the United States had some very good plans for Cuba and will take care of the country. Cuba has been a U.S. antagonist for decades, since Fidel Castro's 1959 revolution. Trump is strongly supported by hardline Cuban-Americans in Florida, who have pushed for U.S.-instigated regime change for decades. The Republican U.S. president has made clear he wants to see change in their homeland.

item.title: US opposes part of Apple contempt finding in Epic Games case at US Supreme Court
item.description: President Donald Trump’s administration is backing key arguments in Apple's US Supreme Court appeal of a ruling that held the company in contempt in a lawsuit by “Fortnite” maker Epic Games.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump’s administration is backing key arguments in Apple's (AAPL.O) US Supreme Court appeal of a ruling that held the company in contempt in a lawsuit by “Fortnite” maker Epic Games. Here are the details: In a friend-of-the-court brief on Monday, the Justice Department urged the justices to narrow the grounds for holding parties in civil contempt. Such an order would benefit Apple, but the DOJ said it filed its brief in support of neither Apple nor Epic Games. The justices [USN:S0N41Y018 TEXT:"agreed in June"] to hear Apple’s challenge to a judge’s decision in California federal court that found the iPhone maker in civil contempt for allegedly violating an earlier order. Epic sued Apple in 2020, alleging it violated antitrust law through its controls on app transactions. Epic won an injunction that mandated sweeping new rules for Apple’s lucrative app store. Epic subsequently accused Apple of violating that order when it set a new 27% commission on certain “off-app” purchases. The lower court said Apple violated the “spirit” of the injunction when it crafted the new commission rate and held the company in contempt in April 2025. Apple’s appeal and the Justice Department’s brief contend the lower court wrongly concluded that Apple could be held in contempt for such an alleged violation, where an injunction does not expressly forbid conduct on which a contempt finding is based. “Civil contempt is therefore appropriate only if the defendant’s conduct is clearly covered by the injunction’s express terms,” the Justice Department wrote in its brief. The government said that the Supreme Court should use the Apple appeal to clarify for lower judges how to apply a standard that permits contempt findings only when there is “no fair ground of doubt” that a party violated a court order. The Justice Department said Apple’s conduct related to at least one part of the lower judge’s order supported a contempt finding. Apple has denied violating the lower court’s injunction. Apple and the Justice Department did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Epic Games chief executive officer Tim Sweeney earlier this month said "Apple has been evading court rulings and regulatory decisions for years, and we aim to bring these practices to a close." The case is Apple Inc v. Epic Games Inc, US Supreme Court, No. 25-1311. For Apple: Gregory Garre of Latham & Watkins For Epic Games: Gary Bornstein of Cravath, Swaine & Moore For the US: D. John Sauer of the Justice Department Read more: [USN:L6N45A08Q TEXT:"US judge denies OpenAI bid to review X Corp’s settlement with Apple"] [USN:S0N41Y018 TEXT:"US Supreme Court to hear Apple appeal of contempt in Epic Games lawsuit"] [USN:L1N3W50S8 TEXT:"Apple wins partial reversal of sanctions in Epic Games antitrust lawsuit"]

item.title: Saudi Aramco plans reorganisation to create gas division, sources say
item.description: Saudi oil giant Aramco plans to reorganise its business to create a new gas division with an eye on possible listings of business units in the future to raise cash, two sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Shadia Nasralla
item.content:encoded: Saudi oil giant Aramco (2222.SE) plans to reorganise its business to create a new gas division with an eye on possible listings of business units in the future to raise cash, two sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters. The move is in line with an existing strategy at Gulf state oil companies of offering outside investors pieces of their businesses while retaining operational control and largely avoiding opening up their main oil-producing divisions. Such deals have included the United Arab Emirates' state oil company ADNOC listing stakes in gas, drilling and retail fuel businesses. Aramco is publicly listed but also has listed subsidiaries such as petrochemicals giant SABIC. Both ADNOC and Aramco have also raised billions of dollars from infrastructure assets such as oil and gas pipelines. Aramco declined to comment. The new gas business would allow Aramco to use a focused platform from which to develop its natural gas resources domestically and build a liquefied natural gas (LNG) portfolio abroad. Aramco, long the engine of the economy in the world's largest crude exporter before the US-Israeli war on Iran disrupted its main export routes, has been seeking [USN:L6N42P163 TEXT:"outside capital"] in its efforts to support the kingdom's drive to reduce its reliance on oil. GAS ARM TO STAND ALONGSIDE UPSTREAM AND DOWNSTREAM DIVISIONS The reorganisation would move Aramco from two main business segments — upstream and downstream — to three, with each unit having its own president, one of the sources said, adding that the company was also exploring other ways to raise cash, including lease-and-leaseback agreements. Gulf state oil companies have used such deals to lease certain assets to an investor group for an upfront payment and then lease it back, maintaining operational control while paying usage fees over an agreed number of years. Aramco is also exploring a potential listing of a minority stake in the gas business as one option to raise cash, the second source said, pointing to Aramco's minority listing on the Saudi Exchange in 2019 as a model. JAFURAH AT THE HEART OF ARAMCO'S DOMESTIC GAS BUSINESS The crown jewel of Aramco's domestic gas business is Jafurah, an unconventional field that is potentially the biggest shale gas project outside the United States. Jafurah, which began operating last year, was envisioned displacing oil used for power generation with natural gas, freeing more crude oil for export. Aramco has said its unconventional gas programme, in which Jafurah is key, at peak production is expected to generate electricity equivalent to displacing 500,000 barrels per day of crude. Aramco last year raised $11 billion from a lease and leaseback agreement of its Jafurah gas processing facilities with a consortium led by Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock (BLK.N) .

item.title: 湾岸諸国、トランプ米大統領にイランとの戦闘激化避けるよう要請へ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 湾岸アラブ諸国は22日、トランプ米大統領との会談で、イランとの戦闘をこれ以上激化させないよう求める見通しだ。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにした。

サウジアラビア、アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）、カタールなど6カ国で構成する湾岸協力会議（GCC）の当局者は、ニューヨークで開かれる国連総会に合わせたトランプ氏との会談を前に、協議を重ねている。関係者らは、機微に触れる内容だとして匿名を条件に語った。

GCC諸国は戦争の終結を強く望んでいる。イランはこれまで、数千に上るミサイルや無人機で湾岸各国の領土や船舶を攻撃してきた。また、ホルムズ海峡の通航混乱が長引いていることを主な要因に、域内経済も縮小または大幅に減速している。

ただ、イランへの対応を巡っては、湾岸諸国の足並みがそろっていない。イランはエネルギー輸送の要衝であるホルムズ海峡で、船舶の通航を管理する権利が自国にあると主張しており、これを巡っても各国の見方は分かれている。それでも各国は、米国とイスラエルが2月下旬に始めた戦争の終結に向け、トランプ氏との会談を足掛かりにしたい考えだ。

トランプ氏の方針は定まっていない。開戦からまもなく7カ月となる中、イランへの追加爆撃を示唆する一方、合意を目指す考えも示してきた。トランプ氏は週末、FOXニュースに対し、今週ニューヨークでイランのペゼシュキアン大統領と会談する可能性があると語った。ただ、会談が実現する兆しは今のところない。

「私は大きな決断を下さなければならない」と、トランプ氏は22日、ニューヨークで開かれた国連総会の一般討論演説で述べた。同氏は「イランが国を立て直し、かつてないほど偉大な国を築けるような合意が成立するのか。それとも、私がイランを一気に壊滅させるのか」と続けた。

トランプ氏はさらに、11月3日の米中間選挙後には、イランが「合意に応じる」との見方を示した。

イランは以前から、原油の輸出や重要物資の輸入を阻む米国の海上封鎖が解除されない限り、協議を再開しないとしている。海上封鎖の影響もあり、イランのインフレ率は90%近くまで加速し、闇市場では通貨リアルが急落した。それでも、イラン指導部が態度を軟化させる兆しはない。

item.title: UK police say they have thwarted plot to attack Jewish community
item.description: British counter-terrorism police said on Tuesday they had arrested two people as part of an investigation into a suspected terrorist plot to target the Jewish community in northern England.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British counter-terrorism police said on Tuesday they had arrested two people as part of an investigation into a suspected terrorist plot to target the Jewish community in northern England. Police said the two men, aged in their 30s, were arrested in central Manchester on Sunday under counter-terrorism legislation with searches also carried out in Salford and Liverpool. "This has been a long-running proactive investigation which has led to the disruption of what we believe to be a plot to target the Jewish community in the Manchester area," Vicki Evans, Senior National Coordinator for Counter Terrorism Policing, said in a statement. She said detectives did not believe that there was any ongoing threat, but police in Manchester said they had stepped up a policing operation during upcoming Jewish High Holy days. The two men were being held in custody in London while further investigations are being carried out. Almost a year ago, two Jewish worshippers were killed in [USN:L1N43O0U6 TEXT:"an attack on a synagogue"] in Manchester during Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar, which was committed by a British citizen of Syrian descent who had said he was acting for Islamic State. "We are acutely aware this news will cause further concern to the Jewish community, as well as the wider public, especially given the significant High Holy day period," Evans said. "I want to reassure them we are working incredibly closely with colleagues in Greater Manchester Police and partners to ensure we’re doing everything we can to keep them and the wider public safe." Britain has seen a significant rise in antisemitism since the Hamas attacks on Israel in October 2023 which triggered the subsequent war in Gaza. There was a [USN:L8N41C2PL TEXT:"spate of arson attacks"] on targets linked to the Jewish community in London earlier this year, while in April two Jewish men [USN:L8N41C1E3 TEXT:"were stabbed"] in what police said was a suspected terrorist incident. That led Britain to raise its national terrorism threat level to "severe", with then-Prime Minister Keir Starmer saying the country's 290,000 Jews were living in fear.

item.title: Argentina vê potencial para produção recorde de grãos na safra 2026/27
item.description: Um aumento esperado nas safras de soja e milho da Argentina na temporada 2026/27 pode levar a produção total de grãos a um novo recorde, informou a Bolsa de Cereais de Buenos Aires nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um aumento esperado nas safras de soja e milho da Argentina na temporada 2026/27 pode levar a produção total de grãos a um novo recorde, informou a Bolsa de Cereais de Buenos Aires nesta terça-feira. A previsão é que a produção de soja atinja 53,6 milhões de toneladas métricas, ante 50,1 milhões de toneladas na temporada 2025/26. A produção de milho deve subir para 66 milhões de toneladas, ante 64 milhões no ciclo anterior. A Argentina é a maior exportadora mundial de óleo e farelo de soja e a terceira maior exportadora de milho. "Estamos vindo da maior safra da nossa história e hoje vemos potencial para produzir novamente nesses níveis", disse o gerente-geral da bolsa, Ramiro Costa, acrescentando que a Argentina poderia produzir um volume recorde de 157,9 milhões de toneladas de grãos no ciclo 2026/27. Costa ressaltou que a confirmação da previsão dependerá da evolução das condições climáticas e das decisões de produção nos próximos meses. Para o trigo da safra 2026/27, a bolsa projetou uma queda na produção para 23,4 milhões de toneladas, ante os 27,8 milhões de toneladas produzidos na temporada anterior. A Argentina também é uma importante fornecedora global de trigo. No início deste mês, a Bolsa de Comércio de Rosário estimou a safra de soja da Argentina em 2026/27 em 47,8 milhões de toneladas e a colheita de milho em até 70,5 milhões de toneladas. (Por Maximilian Heath)

item.title: トランプ氏、米政府文書で「ＡＩ」に代わり「超知能」使用へ 国連演説
item.description: [国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[国連　２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、米政府の文書では今後、人工知能（ＡＩ）に代わり「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス）」という表現を使用する方針を明らかにした。ＡＩに関する警告は「デマ」だとする従来の主張も改めて繰り返した。

トランプ氏は国連総会での演説で「今後、米国の全ての文書、そしてできれば世界中の文書においても、『人工（アーティフィシャル）』という表現の代わりに、はるかに正確な『超（スーパー）』という用語を使用するよう変更される。つまり『超知能』だ」と述べた。

その上で「産業革命を超える規模となるものの成長を、私は抑え込むつもりはない」との考えを示した。

item.title: Trump diz que Departamento de Justiça dos EUA pode frear empresas de IA, se necessário
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reiterou sua oposição a novas regulamentações sobre a tecnologia de inteligência artificial, afirmando aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral da ONU, nesta terça-feira, que as agências de segurança pública dos EUA controlarão o setor, se necessário.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reiterou sua oposição a novas regulamentações sobre a tecnologia de inteligência artificial, afirmando aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral da ONU, nesta terça-feira, que as agências de segurança pública dos EUA controlarão o setor, se necessário. “Vamos acompanhar isso de perto por meio do Departamento de Justiça”, disse Trump, referindo-se à tecnologia de IA e à principal agência de aplicação da lei dos EUA. A preocupação pública com o perigo potencial representado pela inteligência artificial está crescendo, depois que o pesquisador da Anthropic Jacob Coxon renunciou e afirmou: “as pessoas que desenvolvem IA acreditam sinceramente que ela poderia matar a todos nós até o final da década”. Nas últimas semanas, Trump descartou os alarmes sobre a IA, argumentando que tais alegações são uma “farsa.” “Não vou sufocar o crescimento de algo que será maior do que a Revolução Industrial,” disse ele. Trump também disse que, daqui para frente, os documentos do governo dos EUA usarão o termo “superinteligência” em vez de inteligência artificial. (Reportagem de Courtney Rozen, em Washington, e Gram Slattery, nas Nações Unidas)

FAST

UNITED NATIONS, Sept 22 : President Donald Trump reiterated his opposition to new regulations on AI technology, telling global leaders at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday that US law enforcement agencies would rein in the sector if needed.  "We're going to watch it closely through the Department of Justice," Trump said, referring to AI technology and the top US law enforcement agency.  Public alarm about the potential danger posed by artificial intelliegence is growing, after Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned and said, "people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade."  Trump in recent weeks has dismissed alarms about AI, arguing that such claims are a "hoax."  "I'm not going to stifle growth of something that will be bigger than the Industrial Revolution," he said. Trump also said US government documents would use the term "super intelligence" going forward instead of artificial intelligence.

Source: Reuters
